patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: It came on at the cinema — the dark, they tell me. There are rainbow rings around every light, and I've been throwing up from the pain.
presentation.triageNote: 66-year-old female with four hours of severe one-sided eye pain with coloured haloes and vomiting; the eye is red with a mid-dilated non-reactive pupil and feels hard.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because severe unilateral eye pain, halos, vomiting, a hard red eye, and a fixed mid-dilated pupil threaten permanent vision within hours.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has an acute high-pressure eye syndrome requiring rapid pressure reduction and ophthalmic care.
clinical.acuityReason: Severe unilateral eye pain, halos, vomiting, a hard red eye, and a fixed mid-dilated pupil threaten permanent vision within hours.
expectedResources: Immediate visual acuity and intraocular-pressure assessment
keyFindings: Four hours of severe one-sided eye pain
redFlags: Threatened vision from acute ocular hypertension
teachingPoints: Headache with vomiting and a red eye gets misfiled as migraine or gastroenteritis. A hard globe with a mid-dilated fixed pupil is angle closure, and threatened vision within hours makes this a high-risk time-critical the assigned acuity presentation.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate medical pressure reduction would be followed by definitive ophthalmic laser or surgical treatment.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 66-year-old woman in a blouse and cardigan, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting hunched with one hand shielding her left eye from the light, a small basin in her lap. Expression: in severe pain, squinting hard against the light. Clearly visible: one markedly red inflamed eye; a hand shielding that eye from the light; a basin held in the lap. Overall: in severe pain and nauseated, otherwise stable. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
